span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Consciousness arises from a system's capacity to integrate information, so that networks supporting it must strike an optimal balance between functional integration and differentiation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Loss of consciousness occurs through a breakdown of cortical effective connectivity, so that a local perturbation can no longer propagate as a widespread differentiated causal interaction
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Preserved cortical backward (top-down) connections generate the larger long-latency evoked components seen in MCS relative to VS/UWS
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The assessment is gated by behaviour, so absence of response is not proof of absence of consciousness.
span.note: what this limits: any bedside diagnosis of unawareness: the authors state the assessment is intrinsically gated by behavioral responsiveness and that absence of observed purposeful behaviors cannot be taken as definitive proof of the absence of consciousness
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The misdiagnosis rate is given together with the assessment method that produces it.
span.note: what this limits: any quoted misdiagnosis rate for unawareness: up to 40% applies Quotation withheld
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A named patient group is misdiagnosed despite preserved awareness.
span.note: what this limits: any diagnosis of a disorder of consciousness: locked-in syndrome patients can be misdiagnosed as DOC despite preserved awareness, because of complete paralysis of voluntary muscles except vertical eye movements
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The neuroimaging paradigm's validity rests on a control study the authors say is still needed.
span.note: what this limits: any use of an active-task neuroimaging paradigm as evidence of willful response: the authors state validation studies should be performed to ensure passive listening cannot elicit a similar brain activity pattern
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the normalized Lempel-Ziv complexity measure, originally defined for finite symbol sequences, is computed on TMS-evoked EEG spatiotemporal response maps to yield the perturbational complexity index

span.label: a separate experiment run on the same task
span.note: eliminates: reflexive activation as the source of the response, and so establishes the task's specificity to conscious responses

span.label: the 40% misdiagnosis rate - CONDITIONAL ON THE INSTRUMENT: it applies to diagnosis based solely on clinical consensus without appropriate behavioral scales, so the number measures a practice rather than a difficulty, and the practice is nameable and fixable
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the active-task paradigm - VALID ONLY IF A CONTROL HOLDS THAT HAS NOT BEEN RUN: its status as evidence of willful response depends on passive listening not producing a similar pattern, and the authors say validation studies should be performed to establish that
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: qualifies → Ferreira (2007), Manning (2012)
span.note: differs in: WHO IS APPLYING THE CATEGORY. The law is stated as turning on the label - 'the right of the medical team TO WITHDRAW artificial nutrition and hydration from patients in VS/UWS, BUT NOT THOSE IN MCS' - and then: 'Opinions on these end-of-life decisions VARY, HOWEVER, depending NOT ONLY ON THE DIAGNOSIS of the patient, Quotation withheld'. So the same category, on the same patient, does not determine the same decision
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: contradicts → the assumption that locked-in patients have poor quality of life
span.note: differs in: WHO IS ASKED. The quality-of-life question 'is DIFFICULT TO ADDRESS IN THE ABSENCE OF COMMUNICATION with the patient' - and where communication IS possible the answer inverts: 'it is STRIKING to note, however, that Quotation withheld'. The inference drawn from outside about a state is contradicted by the only group in that state who can answer
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: builds-on → Schnakers et al. (2009)
span.note: differs in: WHICH INSTRUMENT PRODUCED THE DIAGNOSIS. The 40% figure is not a property of the patients: misdiagnosis is that frequent 'Quotation withheld', and the review names the scale that does better in the next sentence. Quoted without its condition, the number describes the population rather than the procedure
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: clinical consensus —causes→ Misdiagnosis of unawareness
span.note: holds when: when diagnosis rests on clinical consensus alone, without appropriate behavioral scales · direction on the measure: increases · strength of the relation: 1
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Unawareness is misdiagnosed in up to 40% of cases when clinicians rely on consensus impression instead of a standardised behavioural scale.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only about one in five patients with disorders of consciousness produces a positive response on active command-following neuroimaging paradigms.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A negative result on an active paradigm is uninterpretable as evidence of unconsciousness, because aphasia, apraxia, fluctuating vigilance or unwillingness can all produce it.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The perturbational complexity index separates conscious from unconscious states across subjects and conditions, staying above 0.31 in wakefulness, MCS, EMCS, LIS and REM sleep and below 0.31 in NREM sleep, vegetative state and anaesthesia.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: No conventional neuroimaging technique on its own is adequate to diagnose consciousness in a brain-damaged patient.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Preserved PET metabolism cannot serve as proof of consciousness, since metabolism can be normal or raised during epileptic seizures in which the subject is unconscious.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: TMS delivered during NREM sleep, midazolam anaesthesia and vegetative state elicits only a local stereotypical slow wave, indicating a breakdown of effective connectivity, whereas conscious states give widespread differentiated responses.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Neuroimaging and electrophysiology reliably separate MCS from VS/UWS at the group level, but single-subject interpretation of the same measures is often not possible.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Roughly 20% of patients diagnosed as vegetative show an atypical brain activity pattern, so outliers are expected in any group study.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The contents of consciousness in MCS remain inaccessible because these patients cannot give the reports on which content assessment normally depends.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
